checks.description: WP-00/G0 D1 Unit, Injection, Concurrency, and Canary Suite (26 tests)
WP-00/G0 D2 Scaffold Honest Behavior and Fail-Closed Suite (4 tests)
Focused Mutation Sensitivity Suite on Temporary Code Copies (3 mutations caught)
Live Native Supabase 2.121.0 Lifecycle & Readiness Verification with Real Transports
Isolated Clean Installation Proof via Locked npm ci in Absent Directory
Model and Design Physical ERD Provenance Parity Verification

review_findings_disposition.R1: RESOLVED: Native project_root/workdir points to private disposable config-only Git fixture (.wp00-runs/<runId>/fixture) with initial commit of supabase/config.toml. Native stack operations do not touch repository root. Cache pre-population removed. Member UUID map continuity verified against fresh status under run lock (counterexample N04 proves rejection).
review_findings_disposition.R2: RESOLVED: Dispatcher unified under run lock. Strict orphan recovery requires harness PID death AND /proc provider process quiescence AND socket port quiescence. Multi-match prepare crash retains same intent and marks RECOVERY_REQUIRED. Process/socket observer accurately inspects Linux /proc/net/tcp for TCP_LISTEN state ('0A') with bounded retry.
review_findings_disposition.R3: RESOLVED: Lowest transport adapters implemented. pgClientFactory with explicit host/port/user/password/database configuration and stripped PG* environment. HTTP fetch probes require status 200, redirect: 'error', and timers cleared in finally blocks. P01-P03 assertions evaluate exact call counts and payloads.
review_findings_disposition.R4: RESOLVED: Runner-base enforces mandatory --run <runId> under exclusive run lock with live status and member UUID reconciliation. Arbitrary binding files and temp-root bypass paths completely eliminated. Absent suites return STATUS: NOT EXECUTED with exit code 1.
review_findings_disposition.R5: RESOLVED: projectFiniteOutput strictly projects allowlisted enums and predefined safe messages. Caller message overrides and raw provider error snippets are rejected. Unregistered synthetic canary injected through CLI streams, parser failures, pg exceptions, fetch exceptions, and teardown errors verified 100% absent from stdout, stderr, and evidence logs without leaking on assertion failure.
review_findings_disposition.R6: RESOLVED: Real native R01 execution completed against fresh disposable native stack with real PostgreSQL 17.11 SELECT queries, Auth 200, Storage 200, Mail 200. Session pooler accurately reported as DISABLED_IN_NATIVE_STACK with note on A2 requirement. Complete SAFE logs with exact command, cwd, exit, and stdout/stderr recorded.
